description: EU Taxonomy (Regulation 2020/852, used in CSRD reporting) lookup from the European Commission's Taxonomy Compass API: taxonomy-eligible activities by NACE code or keyword, with sector, NACE codes and environmental objectives; for one activity its substantial-contribution and do-no-significant-harm criteria as text. Activity rules only, not company disclosures. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

activityId.description: Compass activity id (from a list result) to get its screening criteria

lang.description: Language code, default en (24 EU languages)

nace.description: NACE Rev.2 code or prefix, e.g. D35.11, C23.51, F41

objective.description: Filter by objective: mitigation, adaptation, water, circular, pollution, biodiversity

q.description: Keyword in the activity name, e.g. solar, cement, hydrogen
